description: PokeHOAS application root scope, orchestrating container bootstrapping, REST API endpoints, the core Pokémon game engine with battle and progression mechanics, and offline PokeAPI data ingestion scripts.

components.name: Core Game Engine
components.description: Implements core game logic including encounters, battles, abilities, breeding, trading, items, persistence, and background tasks.

components.name: Combat and Creature Mechanics
components.description: Implements core battle simulation, Pokémon moves and abilities, breeding, status effects, and encounter automation rules.

components.name: Trainer Battles and Progression
components.description: Manages NPC trainer encounters, user profiles, training regimens, achievements, and milestone progression rewards.

components.name: Application Lifecycle and Orchestration
components.description: Coordinates FastAPI application lifespans, background event polling loops, database backups, and data seeding routines.

components.name: Economy Evolution and Autoheal
components.description: Handles currency balances, shop item transactions, automated party healing, and Pokémon evolution requirements.

components.name: Competitive PvP and Challenges
components.description: Orchestrates player-versus-player battles, trainer team imports, and challenge arena match resolution.

components.name: Wild Spawning and Rarity
components.description: Determines wild Pokémon spawn pools, generation rarity tiers, shiny rates, and gift encounter distributions.

components.name: Home Assistant Buddy Tracking
components.description: Integrates with Home Assistant sensor feeds to track walking steps, apply buddy exp and egg hatching, and discover items.

components.name: Technical Machines and Debugging
components.description: Manages Technical Machine move teaching compatibilities and god mode administrative overrides.

components.name: Database Persistence Layer
components.description: Provides database connection management, schema initialization, query execution, and core persistence models.
